videos.title: I Lived With You
videos.description: A penniless Russian Prince is befriended by Ada who takes him home to live with her folks.

videos.title: Scotland Yard
videos.description: A stolen car used in a bank robbery proves too fast for the squad car.

videos.title: The Adventures of William Tell
videos.description: Accused of murdering a partisan helper and stealing his gold, Tell must find a way to prove his innocence and face his accuser, whom he believes is the real killer.

videos.title: Object Z
videos.description: A mysterious object is sighted heading towards Earth and causes panic. But what is the nature and origin of the object, and how can it be stopped?

videos.title: William at the Circus
videos.description: William and the boys go back to London to see the prime minister at Downing Street but end up causing mayhem at a funfair.

videos.title: There Was An Old Woman Who Lived In A Shoe
videos.description: A twist of the classic 18th century English nursery rhyme where a Bullfrog Landlord threatens to evict a Washerwoman Mouse and her children when she's unwilling to marry him.

videos.title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
videos.description: Hawkeye has tracked outlaw Simon Girty to Morristown but he and Chingachgook are turned away and told that the town is closed due to an outbreak of the black plague. Hawkeye decides to sneak in and see for himself.

videos.title: The Lone Ranger
videos.description: Tonto receives an urgent message to meet Chief Swift Eagle, while army deserters plot to kill Tonto and Chief Swift Eagle.

videos.title: Supercar
videos.description: The US Navy are testing a new deep-dive bathysphere when disaster strikes, putting the crew in peril. Using a new invention, the Supercar team spring into action in a daring attempt to save the trapped crew.

videos.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
videos.description: A man who claims to be Thor's spokesperson tries to terrorise an island to obtain control and power of its people.

videos.title: Zontar, the Thing From Venus
videos.description: A scientist believes that an inhabitant of Venus has come to rid the Earth of man's greed and inhumanity.

videos.title: The Blue Lamp
videos.description: A seminal film from the Ealing Studios that set out to show the work of the London police. PC George Dixon, the archetypal British bobby, is joined by a new recruit. Arriving at the scene of a domestic, Dixon is shot by Tom Riley and the film moves towards a climactic chase at the White City stadium.

videos.title: The Scales of Justice
videos.description: Five strangers band together to exact revenge on a man who ruined them financially.

videos.title: Three Coins in the Fountain
videos.description: Three American women in Rome each toss a coin into the Trevi Fountain hoping for love. Of course, they find it with three very different men, but not without misunderstandings and mishaps along the way.

videos.title: Look at Life
videos.description: Originally shot on Eastmancolor film stock, a 1960s look at the chaos brought in by ice and snow each year in Britain, why it happens in an age of scientific miracles, and what is being done about it.

videos.title: Dick Turpin
videos.description: Turpin and Swiftnick come to the aid of a woman calling herself 'Mrs Brownlow', who is being blackmailed by Captain Spiker. Unfortunately, Turpin gets caught and is sentenced to death by hanging.

videos.title: Maigret
videos.description: Parisian detective chief superintendent Maigret investigates murder cases.

videos.title: Lillie
videos.description: Edward is scandalised when Lillie begins a liaison with the impetuous Crown Prince Rudolph of Austria. When the Prince of Wales hears that Rudolph is so smitten with Lillie, he arranges to have her presented at court as his official consort. But when legendary actress Sarah Bernhardt threatens Lillie's position as Bertie's mistress, Lillie oversteps the bounds of propriety.

videos.title: The Paper Chase
videos.description: A law student faces an uphill battle when he learns that his tyrannical professor is also his girlfriend's father.

videos.title: Confessions of a Pop Performer
videos.description: A performer with a multitude of solid-gold hits displays more than musical talent.

videos.title: Eurotrash
videos.description: Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, special guests include Avari, Celebrity Flasher: Adriana Sklenarikova, Gunther Brendel, Philip Mond, Coumba Gawlo and Lolo Bounces Up and Down.

videos.title: Yanky Panky
videos.description: Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society.

videos.title: Adventures of a Private Eye
videos.description: Romantic entanglements hinder a novice private detective's investigation into a blackmail case.

videos.title: Four Star Playhouse
videos.description: A doctor caring for natives on a tropical island is dismissed by the bully owner of the island who discovered a discrepancy in his medical past.

videos.title: Look at Life
videos.description: Originally shot on 35mm Eastmancolor Kodak film stock, a 1960s look behind the scenes of industry inside the United Kingdom, exploring what was being done to improve Britain's output.

videos.title: One Step Beyond
videos.description: After a tsunami threatens a wheelchair-bound woman, she is saved by her deaf neighbour and possibly unseen forces.

videos.title: All Living Things
videos.description: A sick boy is cured when his father, who is a vivisectionist, brings home his stolen dog. This incident makes the Professor reconsider his use of animals in his research.

videos.title: The Man in the Mirror
videos.description: A mild-mannered, somewhat mousy man is astounded when his reflection in a mirror comes to life and begins to do all the wild and crazy things that he always wanted to but never could.

videos.title: Sherlock Holmes
videos.description: Holmes and Watson try to rescue a prisoner.

videos.title: Our Man in Havana
videos.description: A wry adaptation of Graham Greene's novel. After being recruited as a British agent in Havana, a vacuum-cleaner salesman begins to fabricate information to earn extra cash. The chief of police grows suspicious of his actions and spies on him - unaware that he too is being spied upon by the salesman.

videos.title: Scotland Yard
videos.description: The quiet of an idyllic port town is shattered when a body is found on the beach.

videos.title: IWM: Salvage with a Smile
videos.description: Second World comedy short explaining the value of salvage with Kathleen Harrison and Ronald Shiner.

videos.title: Reach for the Sky
videos.description: The true story of WWII fighter pilot ace Douglas Bader, who lost both legs in a flying accident, but confounded both his doctor's expectations and those of the RAF, by learning to walk in time to marry sweetheart Thelma and to pass flying school. Bader was shot down over France and captured. His indefatigable resolve saw him try to escape so often, and eventually he was confined to Colditz until the end of the war.

videos.title: Waterworld
videos.description: Actor and narrowboat enthusiast David Suchet joins the battle to save a stretch of historic Midlands canal threatened by a new road, and conservationists try to rescue the native water voles.

videos.title: That's My Boy
videos.description: Ida becomes distraught when her brother Wilfred vanishes from the halfway house. More drama ensues once he's found.

videos.title: For the Love of Ada
videos.description: When a gentleman admirer starts flirting with Ada, she is flattered, but Walter doesn't approve.

videos.title: The Man From U.N.C.L.E.
videos.description: Solo and Illya investigate a possible rejuvenation process developed by THRUSH. With Vera Miles and Maurice Evans.

videos.title: The Footage Detectives
videos.description: Pete Murray gives the lowdown on the New Musical Express, join Noel for 'Home Movie Day' at London's Cinema Museum and there's ballroom dancing at the Hammersmith Palais in the swinging 60s.

videos.title: Enemy at the Door
videos.description: A Prussian officer learns of Reinecke's affair with a local prostitute and attempts to humiliate him - but the plan backfires.

videos.title: Will Success Spoil Rock Hunter?
videos.description: An ad executive hopes to raise his stock in the company by acquiring the endorsement services of a sexy movie star.

videos.title: Look at Life
videos.description: Originally shot on 35mm Eastmancolor Kodak film stock, a 1960s archival look at the lighthouses and light-ships functioning on and around the United Kingdom's coasts, at that time.

videos.title: Fox
videos.description: Following Billy Fox, an outwardly retired Covent Garden market porter living in Clapham with his family, who have gangland connections in London's East End.

videos.title: The Boys From Brazil
videos.description: The story of the Nazi doctor Josef Mengele and his bid to propagate the Aryan race in modern-day Paraguay by cloning Hitler. An ageing Jewish Nazi hunter is alerted to a bizarre series of murders - all of the men with dark-haired, blue-eyed sons - and he sets out to prevent the nightmarish resurrection.

videos.title: The Heritage Chart Show
videos.description: 'TOTP' style programming for heritage artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Featuring songs from popular artists, both live and on video, with the odd interview.

videos.title: Crosstrap
videos.description: A writer and his wife look forward to a holiday in their honeymoon bungalow, but are caught between rival jewel thieves.

videos.title: The Public Enemy
videos.description: Tom Powers and Matt Doyle, two tough young kids growing up poor in Chicago, work for Putty Nose, a fence. He sets up a robbery deal for them, promising to get them out of trouble if anything goes wrong, but when they bungle the job he abandons them. From there they work their way further into the criminal world.

videos.title: Make a Meal of Cheese
videos.description: A wonderful promo film issued by the Cheese Information Service to tie in with a book of yummy recipes.

videos.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
videos.description: The local baker thinks ghosts are behind his suffering at the mill, but Robin suspects someone more solid is behind his troubles.

videos.title: Supercar
videos.description: The US Navy are testing a new deep-dive bathysphere when disaster strikes, putting the crew in peril. Using a new invention, the Supercar team spring into action in a daring attempt to save the trapped crew.

videos.title: The Vise
videos.description: Penny cannot decide between dependable George or wealthy Mark but while on a walk together, George falls to his death.

videos.title: The Detectives
videos.description: Russo is a captive of an arrested mobster's associates.

videos.title: Murder at 3am
videos.description: A Scotland Yard detective investigates a serial killer on the loose who makes a habit of murdering women on the street at precisely 3 am.

videos.title: Ladies of Leisure
videos.description: Wealthy artist Jerry Strong asks a striking call-girl to pose for him, but their budding relationship is complicated by his friend and his interfering parents.

videos.title: What's on TPTV with Noel
videos.description: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout December.

videos.title: Z Cars
videos.description: The public expect to be protected by the police, but if a policeman kills a member of the public, will the protector be protected?

videos.title: Son of a Stranger
videos.description: A young man searches for the father he never knew, with the belief that he is a rich aristocrat.

videos.title: Soundie - Betty Brewer
videos.description: The wonderful Betty Brewer sings I'm Gonna Sit Right Down and Write Myself a Letter.

videos.title: Richard the Lionheart
videos.description: Sir Gilbert, sent to Brittany to bring back Prince Arthur, England's young heir-apparent, is attacked and his place taken by a kidnapper.

videos.title: Five Days
videos.description: A man pays a hitman to kill him. Circumstances change, and he tries to call off the hit, but he has trouble getting the deal killed.

videos.title: Look at Life
videos.description: Originally shot on 35mm Eastmancolor Kodak film stock, providing a 1960s archival look at "modern" technology and how it was used at the time to make life more difficult for lawbreakers.

videos.title: Film Noir
videos.description: With film noir in full flight in Hollywood, a slew of 'bad girls' take centre stage during its classic period, from Rita Hayworth in 'Gilda' to Ava Gardner's starring turn in 'The Killers'.

videos.title: This Happy Breed
videos.description: Dowdy housewife Ethel Gibbons is married to Frank, who has just returned from the war. Ethel had been sharing a house with her daughter Queenie, son Reg, crotchety mother Mrs Flint and spinster sister-in-law Sylvia. Frank returns from the war to move them all into a bigger house in Clapham and the story traces the ups and downs of the family's fortunes as the new peace allows them to reach for a greater standing in life.

videos.title: The Scales of Justice
videos.description: Five strangers band together to exact revenge on a man who ruined them financially.

videos.title: The Footage Detectives
videos.description: Mike and Noel are joined by Isla St Clair where she shares footage and opens up about childhood memories and her career. And there's a reel from one of the first TV stations to transmit from home.

videos.title: Maigret
videos.description: Maigret goes undercover at a boarding house where a woman with two boys is occupying room number four, hence `Mrs Four'. She has fled her home and husband with the boys and is in hiding after seeing a dead woman's body.

videos.title: Murder in Sarlat
videos.description: A corpse is discovered near a castle moat in the medieval town of Sarlat. The murder scene includes references to the 17th century peasant revolt in the region. The investigation is entrusted to police chief Claire Dalmas and captain Éric Pavin, two officers who clearly have a score to settle.

videos.title: The Lawless Years
videos.description: Ruditsky won't take a bribe when a couple of criminals are implicated in a crime, so their gang attempts to frame him.

videos.title: Two Men in Town
videos.description: A former bank robber is released after a 10-year jail sentence. He gets help from a social worker, but soon gets harassed by an old cop from his past.

videos.title: Serious Charge
videos.description: A new vicar falls foul of frustrated Hester as she backs up a false claim made against the Vicar. Cliff Richard sings Living Doll.

videos.title: Glimpses
videos.description: Documentary short exploring the island of Madeira, told from the perspective of a sea captain.

videos.title: Look at Life
videos.description: Originally shot on 35mm Eastmancolor film stock, a 1960s archival look into exploring the 'modern' Roman influence of coffee bars, leather goods and Italian immigrants coming to the United Kingdom.

videos.title: Batman
videos.description: Batman and Robin are alerted when Mooney, a policeman working undercover for The Catwoman, vanishes after warning Gordon she will become allied with a European criminal known as the Sandman.

videos.title: Batman
videos.description: Batman locates Catwoman's lair and manipulates her so that she leads him to Sandman. While O'hara and his men apprehend Catwoman, the dynamic duo pursues Sandman aboard their Batboat.
